MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable Bluetooth speaker complements my headphones by letting me listen away from my desk; its advertised battery life gives me a concrete reason to try it.",
    "Audio was a reasonable connection to my headphone purchases, especially when the suggestion offered a different listening use rather than another similar headset."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers, smart displays and smart plug assume I want voice assistance or home automation, but my purchases do not show a need for either.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender does not address a problem I have identified; my recent adapter and Ethernet cables suggest I am working on wired connections.",
    "My Raspberry Pi and HDMI purchases do not mean I want a streaming stick, and having bought a Kindle does not give me a current reason to buy another screen."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been treated as interest in almost any connected household device.",
    "My Kindle purchase seems to have been stretched into interest in several other Amazon devices, even though they serve different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases cluster around practical computer needs: wired connectivity, carrying a laptop, organizing headphones and cleaning equipment.",
    "My Raspberry Pi, case and cable accessories suggest a specific hands-on project; useful additions would need to fit that project rather than merely offer entertainment.",
    "I interact with many products, but each still needs a clear purpose; frequent activity does not mean I currently need several new devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my interest in electronics and audio but mostly missed my current focus on practical computer accessories and specific setup needs."
}
